احتفلوا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَفَلُوا (iḥtafalū) /iħ.ta.fa.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
# اُحْتُفِلُوا (uḥtufilū) /uħ.tu.fi.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
# اِحْتَفِلُوا (iḥtafilū) /iħ.ta.fi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
